component.name: Eduka-Konekta
component.summary: School chat, exams and attendance over the school network

description.p: Eduka-Konekta is a lightweight, serverless chat application for one trusted school network.

It discovers peers across Ethernet and Wi-Fi, bridges Wi-Fi client isolation through a relay peer, and supports class, group and private chat, announcements, exams and assignments with automatic grading, one-click attendance, school rules, document transfer, a status feed and 30-minute message controls.
Chat session data is erased when closed, while the active profile remains signed in until the user explicitly logs out.
